item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01710","case1_error":"Adds the two mother lambs again even though they are already included in the initial six.","case2_error":"Divides by servings per batch twice, mislabeling 15 batches as servings and reducing the required batch count again.","reason":"The first double-counts members of an existing total; the second repeats a unit conversion on an already converted quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01711","case1_error":"Forms incorrect beaver-to-human and moose-to-human ratios, yielding 9.5 moose per human instead of 1/38.","case2_error":"Evaluates 2,250,000 × 0.02 as 450,000 instead of 45,000.","reason":"The first uses erroneous ratio relations; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written cost expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01712","case1_error":"Counts only two houses in the combined area, omitting Zion's house from the three-house total.","case2_error":"Gives 34 after correct savings-minus-spending formulas, without showing an evaluation; the formulas yield 40.","reason":"The first omits a required house from its total; the second supplies an unsupported incorrect final number after correct formulas.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01713","case1_error":"Evaluates 57 + 190 + 152 as 309 instead of 399.","case2_error":"Multiplies weekday-plus-Saturday earnings by five, effectively counting Saturday earnings five times; weekly earnings should be $400.","reason":"The first is numerical evaluation of a correct expression; the second constructs an incorrect weekly earnings expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01714","case1_error":"Omits one required halving, applying only two halvings over thirty years instead of three.","case2_error":"Omits the Sunday newspaper expense when calculating weekly and eight-week spending.","reason":"Both omit a required contribution to the calculation: one halving event or the Sunday purchase. Their remaining arithmetic is correct.","judgment":"same"}]}
